criteria.given: A fresh empty MySQL 8 schema 'authenticself' with no prior tables.
criteria.when: Spring Boot starts with Flyway enabled and executes the V1 migration.
criteria.then: information_schema.tables for schema 'authenticself' contains exactly the four business tables users, spaces, furniture, wishlist (plus flyway_schema_history).

criteria.given: The V1 migration has been applied.
criteria.when: SHOW COLUMNS FROM users is executed.
criteria.then: Result includes user_id (VARCHAR, NOT NULL, PRI), name (VARCHAR, NOT NULL), email (VARCHAR, NOT NULL, UNI), created_at, updated_at.

criteria.given: The V1 migration has been applied.
criteria.when: SHOW COLUMNS FROM spaces is executed.
criteria.then: Result includes room_id (PK), user_id, dimensions, main_color, style, analysis_date (DATETIME), all NOT NULL.

criteria.given: The V1 migration has been applied.
criteria.when: SHOW COLUMNS FROM furniture is executed.
criteria.then: Result includes furniture_id (PK), type, style, size — all VARCHAR NOT NULL.

criteria.given: The V1 migration has been applied.
criteria.when: SHOW COLUMNS FROM wishlist is executed.
criteria.then: Result includes wishlist_id, user_id, furniture_id, category (all NOT NULL), price of type INT, and status of type ENUM('Active','Purchased') with default 'Active'.

criteria.given: Each of the four business tables exists.
criteria.when: Querying information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_type='PRIMARY KEY' for each table.
criteria.then: Exactly one PRIMARY KEY per table on user_id, room_id, furniture_id, wishlist_id respectively.

criteria.given: The V1 migration has been applied with empty users table.
criteria.when: Attempting INSERT INTO spaces(room_id, user_id, dimensions, main_color, style, analysis_date) VALUES('r1','u_nonexistent','1x1','#fff','Modern', NOW()).
criteria.then: MySQL rejects the insert with error 1452 (a foreign key constraint fails) referencing fk_spaces_user.

criteria.given: The V1 migration has been applied.
criteria.when: Attempting to insert a wishlist row whose user_id does not exist in users.
criteria.then: MySQL rejects with foreign key error 1452 referencing fk_wishlist_user.

criteria.given: The V1 migration has been applied and a valid user exists.
criteria.when: Attempting to insert a wishlist row whose furniture_id does not exist in furniture.
criteria.then: MySQL rejects with foreign key error 1452 referencing fk_wishlist_furniture.

criteria.given: An existing user u1 and furniture f1 exist.
criteria.when: Executing INSERT INTO wishlist(..., status) VALUES(..., 'Pending').
criteria.then: MySQL rejects the insert with a data truncation / invalid enum value error. Inserting status='Active' and status='Purchased' both succeed.

criteria.given: An existing user u1 and furniture f1 exist.
criteria.when: Inserting a wishlist row without specifying the status column.
criteria.then: SELECT status FROM wishlist WHERE wishlist_id=... returns 'Active'.

criteria.given: The V1 migration has been applied.
criteria.when: Executing SHOW INDEX FROM spaces WHERE Key_name='idx_spaces_user_id'.
criteria.then: Exactly one row is returned with Column_name='user_id' and Non_unique=1.

criteria.given: The V1 migration has been applied.
criteria.when: Executing SHOW INDEX FROM wishlist WHERE Key_name='idx_wishlist_user_id'.
criteria.then: Exactly one row is returned with Column_name='user_id' and Non_unique=1.

criteria.when: Listing files matching V1__*.sql and checking flyway_schema_history after Spring Boot starts.
criteria.then: Exactly one file exists named precisely 'V1__init_schema.sql', and flyway_schema_history has one row with version='1', description='init schema', success=1.

criteria.when: Selecting every column_name from information_schema.columns for the four tables.
criteria.then: No column name contains any uppercase letter (regex [A-Z] matches zero column names) — all identifiers are snake_case.

criteria.when: Querying information_schema.tables.TABLE_COLLATION for each of users, spaces, furniture, wishlist.

criteria.given: The Spring Boot project source tree.
criteria.then: Exactly four files exist — User.java, Space.java, Furniture.java, Wishlist.java — each carrying @Entity and @Table(name='<snake_case_table>'), and the module compiles successfully.
